title: Close Cursor
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that lets you instantly release your mouse cursor with a key press without pausing the game.
body:
The mod can no longer receive updates due to the fact that the mod code has been lost.

![Close Cursor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9273f3a3701e86823f756704a58774cd9ad32dd.png)


CloseCursor is a lightweight Fabric mod that allows you to instantly release your mouse cursor with a single key press.

✨ Features

Instant access  
No need to press E or ESC just to free your cursor. Press "O" (the key can be changed in Controls) and your cursor will appear instantly.

No game pause  
Perfect for situations where you need to click something on a second monitor or overlay without pausing the game.

Soft blur  
When the cursor is released, the background smoothly blurs, creating a modern Minecraft-style focus effect.

Lightweight  
The mod uses almost no resources and works well alongside other interface mods.

🔧 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Install Fabric API
3. Download CloseCursor.jar and place it in your .minecraft/mods folder

⚠️ Fabric API is required because the mod uses it to handle key bindings.
